summary.text: Jeff Fortney is the Democratic candidate for Arizona State Senate District 3 in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces incumbent Republican John Kavanagh and write-in candidate Frank Bertone.
He is an at-large member of the Cave Creek Unified School District governing board.

paragraphs.text: Fortney is an at-large member of the Cave Creek Unified School District board, a nonpartisan office, having assumed office on January 1, 2021.
He was among the candidates elected to the board in the November 5, 2024 general election, and his current term ends on January 1, 2029.
He advanced from the Democratic primary for State Senate District 3 on July 21, 2026, with 19,675 votes in an uncontested race.
